definitions.explanation: A systematic set of ideas explaining phenomena, based on reasoning and evidence.

examples.japanese: その{理論|りろん}は{実験|じっけん}で{証明|しょうめい}された。
examples.english: That theory was proven by experiment.

examples.japanese: {理論|りろん}と{実践|じっせん}は{違|ちが}う。
{彼|かれ}の{理論|りろん}は{正|ただ}しいと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think his theory is correct.

notes:
{理論|りろん} is a compound: {理|り} (reason/principle) + {論|ろん} (argument/discourse).

COMMON TYPES:
- {経済|けいざい}{理論|りろん} (economic theory)
- {相対性|そうたいせい}{理論|りろん} (theory of relativity)
- {進化|しんか}{理論|りろん} (evolutionary theory)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理論|りろん}を{立|た}てる (to formulate a theory)
- {理論|りろん}に{基|もと}づく (to be based on theory)
- {理論的|りろんてき}（な） (theoretical)
- {理論|りろん}{武装|ぶそう} (theoretical preparation)

CONTRAST:
- {理論|りろん} (theory - systematic explanation)
- {仮説|かせつ} (hypothesis - proposed explanation to be tested)
- {法則|ほうそく} (law - established principle)
